periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented downwards toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical-oblong oval with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial margin towards the rostrum, with the geometric center located in the upper half of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth, wide U-shape profile across the posterior boundary of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal length from the neck to the base of the tail.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap across the crown, measuring approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly curved semi-circular apex with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent brownish-red oxidation or staining present on the white fur across the dorsal and flank regions.
